items.description: Fabricated evidence or copied reference results presented as independently computed invalidate the submission.
Demonstrated unauthorized use of hidden evaluator answers invalidates the submission. Ordinary failed or incomplete computations only lose the affected scientific items.

ordinary_failure_policy: Missing or unsupported final conclusions fail only the affected items; supported independent outcomes retain their points. Return pass/fail for every item and record demonstrated reference defects separately in objective_issue_flags. No pending scientific-review status.

current_scoring_authority.scope_note: The required molecular explanation concerns catalyst-level structure–activity relationships at initial activation; hypotheses and quantitative molecular comparisons are selected independently. A complete cycle, yield-time model or resolved C/E crossing mechanism is not required.
current_scoring_authority.historical_record_role: Historical/source records are non-scoring provenance. Deleted outcomes and old thresholds are not acceptance requirements; no historical scientific pass is inherited.
